summary: CR-124 retest (focused). Backend: 7/7 targeted tests pass (V5, V6, V2, V1, V17, V7, export single Country Code column + Fir Hills row cc=+1). Import-preview cc-aware dedup verified manually (country_code header): +1/+44/+91 existing rows correctly classified as 'update'. Frontend: customer list shows '+1 1772654157' and '+44 7911123456'; detail profile card and re-engage modal show +cc prefix; edit modal cc select has all 8 COUNTRY_CODES with current value +1 preselected; saving +91 shows 'Enter a valid mobile number' toast, saving +1 shows 'Customer updated successfully!'; QR registration page has cc dropdown. All 4 fixed bugs verified.

minor.issue: Export header is 'Country Code' but import parser only lowercases headers ('country code' with space) and reads 'country_code'. Re-importing an exported CSV silently drops the cc -> foreign numbers default to +91 and fail as 'Invalid phone number' (e.g. Fir Hills row 1772654157) or create a +91 duplicate instead of updating the +44 record. Template (country_code) works fine.

ui_bugs.issue: Country code dropdown is hardcoded with 6 options (+91,+1,+44,+971,+65,+61) and does not use COUNTRY_CODES from constants (missing +81, +86 and flags). Same inconsistency that was fixed in CustomerDetailPage.

issues: DOB/Anniversary use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/date picker
